model_warnings: Amendment A1.1.1 states the Amendment takes effect on 1 January 2025 and applies by Service Date; the header lists an overall effective period of 1 January 2024 to 31 December 2025. The 'Rate to 31 December 2024' column in A1.2 is retained for pre-amendment Service Dates priced under Appendix B.
No effective date range is stated in this chunk; rate effective_from and effective_to are null.

The Daily cap column heading says 'days' for Bedside Vascular Critical Care Occupancy (8 days) and Continuous Immunologic Isolation Room Occupancy (24 days), which may represent a per-stay or per-period cap rather than a strictly daily cap; the limits are recorded as stated.
The chunk specifies non-business-day uplifts but does not define which days qualify as non-business days; uplifts mapped to weekend_uplifts as the closest canonical rule type.
